entities.name: William Henry Gist
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: William Henry Gist was the 68th governor of South Carolina from 1858 to 1860 and a leader of the secession movement in South Carolina. He was one of the signers of the Ordinance of Secession on December 20, 1860, which effectively launched the Confederate States of America.
